text.offer: You wish to be surrounded by the ineffable embrace of our patron Mistress. Your judgement is keen but what of your loyalty? To prove this to me you must invoke Mistress Qor to Priestess Xiana, thus: "In darkness all shall be bound. Our Mistress would walk among men in the comfort of a lightless sky and a bloody moon." After that, return and tell me you are done and we shall revel in the beauty of corruption.
text.complete: You have fulfilled my wishes. You are not only wise but tenacious. Seek me out when you would learn more of Qor's spells of power.

steps.brief: Reconsider your actions, Shal'ille will grant you forgiveness when you are ready to receive it.
